metadata.evidence: + `module has no attribute "placeholder"`: This is because you are using Tensorflow 2, while the code is using Tensorflow 1. Please [disable TF2](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/compat/v1/disable_v2_behavior) behaviors by adding the line `tf.compat.v1.disable_v2_behavior()` after the line of importing TF in all the files.
metadata.reason: Documents a common runtime error and its fix, helping users run the code successfully.
